text: The consequence of a payment match reaches this service in two parts and never as a subscription of its own: the missed or matched installment arrives as the payment signal that CaseWorkflow of rwb-case passes to its stage child TreatmentWorkflow, and the amounts, the rule ID and the package version are read once per plan and business date from the match-consequence read of RWB-P8-E2027-CON with a 2 s timeout behind a breaker. This story therefore publishes no event and consumes no topic in wave 2; the plan consequence is served on the treatment read.
why: The legacy story matched inside one module through RuleEvaluator and TreatmentApi, the design routes the missed-payment event through the case router into the stage workflow, and no source publishes the operation or the payload of the treatment side of a match.

text: The cure period and the break limit are parameter values in force and never code: CURE_PERIOD_DAYS gives 30 calendar days for MORTGAGE and restructure.max_breaks gives 2, both read from the parameters contract of rwb-case at the business date and named in the decision record with their version. The RES rule set of the route is evaluated with the embedded Drools runtime from the package in force of rwb-decision, and the package code and the parameter keys are carried as open contract items.
why: The design gives the two values as an example and names no parameter key, the legacy story fixes both as rule and parameter columns and never in code, and the DP table makes the parameters contract of rwb-case the source.

text: The plan states on the treatment row are PLAN_RUNNING, PLAN_CURE_PERIOD and PLAN_BROKEN, and BACK_TO_ROUTE_DECISION is the case point the stage reports to; the state column of TSD S2 T3.0 holds the three plan states and this service writes none of the case status. A plan is in PLAN_RUNNING from the schedule set, moves to PLAN_CURE_PERIOD on a missed installment, returns to PLAN_RUNNING on a match inside the cure period and to PLAN_BROKEN when the cure timer fires unpaid.
why: PLAN_RUNNING and PLAN_BROKEN appear in the FSD rule tables, PLAN_CURE_PERIOD only in the legacy story section 9, and no data dictionary entry gives the state vocabulary of the treatment row after the split.
